Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, LOKESHWAR SINGH PANTA
Payment of Wages Act, 1936-s. 15(3)-Suit for declaration of age of f retirement-Issue Pending in second appeal-In the meantime application c under the Act and also under U.P. Dookan Aur Vanijya Adhisthan Adhiniyam claiming wages and compensation-Entitlement of the claimant to the wages Held; The claimant could not have been granted compensation in view of proviso to s. 15(3) as there existed a dispute about entitlement of the claimant-A claim cannot be raised under the Act as well asunder the D Adhiniyam-However, some amount of compensation already paid to the claimant, cannot
